name: Taiwan 2050
description: Net-zero pathway: huge solar and wind (onshore and offshore), big batteries and flexible demand, and few spinning machines, so frequency moves fast.
dataNotes: A what-if fleet, not an official plan. Peak load extends the official 1.7%/yr outlook growth from 2025 to 2050. Renewable share follows the 2050 net-zero pathway target of 60–70%; the capacity split and all unit parameters are illustrative. Gas units stand for low-carbon firm capacity (hydrogen-ready or with carbon capture).
